name: Find That Book golden set
how_verified: Canonical work = for (title, author): GET /search.json?title=..&author=..&sort=editions; among works whose normalized main title equals the expected title, the one with the most editions.
Author-only rows: GET /search/authors.json?q=<name>; every author record with that exact name is listed (Open Library has duplicate author records).
Every query was also run raw (GET /search.json?q=<query>&limit=10); observed_live records the raw top-1 and numFound as evidence of difficulty, not as the expectation.
Extra acceptable ids are listed only where Open Library has a second record for the same book, and the note says why.

scoring.top1: candidates[0].work_id in expected.top1 (author rows: candidates[0] has an author in expected.author_keys, or author surname = expected.author_surname)
scoring.top5: any of candidates[0..4] in expected.top5 (author rows: any of the first 5 by the author)
scoring.rows without top1/author: no-answer rows: only status is scored; any 'match' is a false positive
